THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / OCTOBER 2026
NIGHT & LIFESTYLE
167
STUDY 166
Graphic Skull Tank & Mini Dress
Rights check
Source: 25064.jpg
Edgy, bold, nocturnal
WORKING NOTES
- The skull graphic and studded gloves are the defining
details.
- Keep the graphic abstract to avoid readable text in the
image.
Try this: Keep the skull graphic abstract, without readable
text.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with a sleek
black bob and winged eyeliner stands
beside a charging station at night, with
tall illuminated buildings behind her. She
wears a fitted black spaghetti-strap mini
dress with a large silver skull graphic
across the chest. Black fingerless
leather gloves with studs hold a coffee
cup, and a black quilted shoulder bag
hangs at her side. Her expression is
calm and direct. Cool, night-time city
light with warm glints. Palette of black,
silver, and urban blue. Edgy and bold, in
the style of a nightlife street-style photo.
